status: preview: not reviewed by a tax professional for this country

conventions.amounts: decimal strings; fiat in the country currency, rounded half-even to cents after exact computation; quantities exact
conventions.times: ISO 8601 with offset; every date rule uses the local date in `timezone`
conventions.expected: computed by the spec's reference model; `refusal` means the implementation must fail closed with that code

vectors.title: Sale within the year: taxable; acquisition fee raises cost, sale fee is Werbungskosten
Disposal on the anniversary date is still within the year (taxable)
Disposal on the day after the anniversary is outside the period (not taxable)
Acquired 29 Feb: the period ends 28 Feb of the next year (§188 Abs. 3 BGB)
365 elapsed days across 29 Feb are not more than one year: the generic day count would call it long-term
Holding period uses Europe/Berlin dates: a UTC-date implementation gets the opposite answer
One sale consumes an old (exempt) and a new (taxable) lot; Werbungskosten split by quantity (Rn. 57)
2024 total gain 999.99 EUR is below the 1,000 EUR Freigrenze: not taxable
2024 total gain exactly 1,000.00 EUR is not below the Freigrenze: fully taxable
2023 used the 600 EUR Freigrenze: a 600.00 gain is taxable (it would be exempt under the 2024 limit)
Same-year §23 loss nets against §23 gain; the net 800 EUR is below the Freigrenze
A net §23 loss is reported as a loss (only offsettable against §23 gains, §23 Abs. 3 Sätze 7-8)
Crypto-to-crypto swap: proceeds at the received token's value, its cost at the given token's value; new period for USDT
Swap where the received token has no market value: the given token's value is used (Rn. 58 Satz 3)
Lending interest totalling 255.99 EUR is below the §22 Nr. 3 Freigrenze; the coins are acquisitions at that value
Leistung income of exactly 256.00 EUR is not below the Freigrenze: fully taxable
FIFO runs per wallet (Rn. 62): a sale from wallet B takes B's lot even though A holds an older one
Own-wallet transfer carries lots with their dates; the network fee units are a disposal at market value
Rn. 61 main rule: FIFO decides the holding period, the wallet's average cost the value
Paying for goods: proceeds are the agreed EUR price (Rn. 60)
Network fee paid in BTC: the fee units are a disposal of their own (taken first), and their value is Werbungskosten split over the sale
Mining income is reported apart from §22 Nr. 3 until classified (Rn. 34-45: commercial or not)
An airdrop without a reviewed classification fails closed

refusal.reason: airdrop without a reviewed Leistung/gift classification

vectors.title: A BTC to LBTC peg fails closed until the book records an explicit decision

refusal.reason: BTC↔LBTC change needs an explicit book decision

vectors.title: A hard fork needs a cost split by market values (Rn. 67), which is not modelled: fail closed

refusal.reason: Rn. 67: cost split by market-value ratio is not modelled

vectors.title: Received gift without the donor's acquisition data fails closed (§23 Abs. 1 Satz 3)

refusal.reason: §23 Abs. 1 Satz 3: the donor's acquisition date and cost are required
